title: Fix bridge skill manifest references after #122 root move
summary: The documentation for the bcquality-al-review bridge skill was updated to reflect the plugin manifest relocation from `.claude-plugin/plugin.json` to the repository root `plugin.json` after PR #122.
key_points: Plugin root detection now anchors on the root `plugin.json` instead of the deleted `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`
Manifest location notes updated to correctly identify root `plugin.json` as canonical
Documentation-only fix with no runtime behavior changes
Fallback anchor and prose wording aligned with actual plugin structure
quote: The bridge `SKILL.md` prose was not updated to match, so it still pointed at the now-deleted `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`.
